title: News/Event: Rookhallow Tunnel
text: Update13 November 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com Event: Rookhallow Tunnel The Kapirosian Communal Charity has arrived! Join the first Community Project to build a tunnel between Rookborne Basin and Rokhala Mountains. Choose your mining guild, earn Kapi's Koins, and compete for an exclusive reward! Kapirosian Communal Charity A group of worshippers have moved into the Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadows. These are followers of Kapiros, the capybara that roams around the ring road circling the altar. From the learnings of Kapiros themselves, they prioritize cultivating a stronger community in their world. To do this, they currently focus on Community Projects around Erenor that improve settlements and their infrastructure. These projects are progressed in collaboration with existing guilds from across the world, and when a project is active, you'll be able to find their representatives at the Altar of Hata. Rookhollow Tunnel Project The first Community Project is now available, and Kapitan Priest Bruntwick in Swirling Meadows is asking for volunteers. Construction on a tunnel between Rookborne Basin and Rokhala Mountains has finally begun, and the Communal Charity has collaborated with two mining guilds from Haranya and Nuia to hopefully speed up the progress. You'll find representatives from the Royster's Excavation Company and the Glitterstone Mining Guild at the charity's headquarters. Both have a stipend of Kapi's Koins to hand out to contributing volunteers, so it will be worth your while! Once talking to their representative, you'll need to head to the tunnel to work. Royster's are working on the West side of the tunnel (Rookborne Basin) Glitterstone is working on the East side of the tunnel (Rokhala Mountains) The Race To promote some friendly competition, the group of priests have decided to reward something special to the mining guild that reports the most amount of volunteer work completed. To put it plainly: Pick your mining company wisely, this is a competition. There will be a unique reward from the charity to whichever company contributes the most to opening the tunnel. This is not limited to daily quest completions.

== Kapirosian Communal Charity ==
A group of worshippers have moved into the Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadows. These are followers of Kapiros, the capybara that roams around the ring road circling the altar. From the learnings of Kapiros themselves, they prioritize cultivating a stronger community in their world. To do this, they currently focus on '''Community Projects''' around Erenor that improve settlements and their infrastructure. These projects are progressed in collaboration with existing guilds from across the world, and when a project is active, you'll be able to find their representatives at the Altar of Hata.

== Rookhollow Tunnel Project ==
The first Community Project is now available, and Kapitan Priest Bruntwick in Swirling Meadows is asking for volunteers. Construction on a '''tunnel between Rookborne Basin and Rokhala Mountains''' has finally begun, and the Communal Charity has collaborated with two mining guilds from Haranya and Nuia to hopefully speed up the progress. You'll find representatives from the '''Royster's Excavation Company''' and the '''Glitterstone Mining Guild''' at the charity's headquarters. Both have a stipend of Kapi's Koins to hand out to contributing volunteers, so it will be worth your while! Once talking to their representative, you'll need to head to the tunnel to work.
* Royster's are working on the West side of the tunnel (Rookborne Basin)
* Glitterstone is working on the East side of the tunnel (Rokhala Mountains)

== The Race ==
To promote some ''friendly'' competition, the group of priests have decided to reward something special to the mining guild that reports the most amount of volunteer work completed. To put it plainly:

'''Pick your mining company wisely, this is a competition.''' There will be a unique reward from the charity to whichever company contributes the most to opening the tunnel. This is not limited to daily quest completions.
